title: Kummer injection into the Brauer group of a field
statement: Let E be a field [def-pc-field-extension], and let ell be a prime different from the characteristic of E. On the small etale site of Spec E, define $\mu_\ell$ to be the kernel of the ell-th power map $\mathbf G_m\to\mathbf G_m$, where $\mathbf G_m$ is the sheaf of units as in [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Then the Kummer sequence $0\to\mu_\ell\to\mathbf G_m\xrightarrow{x\mapsto x^\ell}\mathbf G_m\to0$ is exact, and the induced map $H^2(\operatorname{Spec}(E)_{\mathrm{Et}},\mu_\ell)\to H^2(\operatorname{Spec}(E)_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_m)$ is injective, with etale cohomology as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

proof.text: Since $\ell$ is different from the characteristic of $E$, it is invertible on $\operatorname{Spec}E$. The arbitrary-base Kummer theorem [lem-amb-kummer-any-base], applied to $T=\operatorname{Spec}E$ and $n=\ell$, gives the exact sequence of etale sheaves $0\to\mu_\ell\to\mathbf G_m\to\mathbf G_m\to0$ appearing in the statement.

Apply the long exact sequence of right derived functors [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-long-exact] to this short exact sequence and the global-sections functor on $(\operatorname{Spec}E)_{\mathrm{Et}}$. Its degree-two portion is $H^1(E,\mathbf G_m)\to H^2(E,\mu_\ell)\to H^2(E,\mathbf G_m)$. The first term is zero by [cor-sc-hilbert-90-field], so exactness makes the map $H^2(E,\mu_\ell)\to H^2(E,\mathbf G_m)$ injective.
